parameters.help_en: The input configuration. OSS addresses and content library material IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 输入配置，支持OSS地址和内容库素材ID
parameters.name: input_file

parameters.help_en: The custom settings. You can pass in business information such as the business environment and task information. The value is a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义设置，可传入客户业务信息，如业务方环境、任务信息，JSON字符串格式
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The task title. The title can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务标题，长度不超过128字节
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The task description. The description can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述，长度不超过128字节
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The audio-to-text recognition configuration:

HotwordLibraryIdList: the list of hotword library IDs. Currently, only one hotword library ID is supported. Support for multiple hotword library IDs is planned for the future.
SentenceMaxLength: the maximum length of each sentence in the output. Type: int.
EnableSemanticSentenceDetection: specifies whether to segment sentences based on semantics in the output. Type: bool. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
音频识别转文字配置：

HotwordLibraryIdList，热词库Id列表，目前仅支持传入一个热词库Id，后续计划支持同时多个热词库Id
SentenceMaxLength，输出结果中的每句话的最大长度，类型：int；
EnableSemanticSentenceDetection，输出结果是否按照语义断句，类型：bool（默认值为false）；
parameters.name: editing_config
